name: repo-standards
description: Preferred GitHub repository standards, audited and applied with `gh` — a repo-settings baseline (wiki/projects off, auto-delete merged branches, read-only workflow token, SHA-pinned actions, Dependabot security updates), three branch-ruleset classes, a Dependabot version-updates config (whose declared `labels:` must exist in the repo first, or Dependabot silently drops them — audited as the `DEPLBL` column), a lightweight tier for content/asset/config repos, the README/CONTRIBUTING/AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md doc split (AGENTS.md canonical when present, CLAUDE.md a thin @import wrapper), and a knowledge-base standard (the agent map as a ~100-line map with hybrid eager-imports + lazy routing that is complete AND exclusive, a gotchas section as its highest-value content, numbered invariants, an in-repo PRD-or-CONTRACT + TESTING docs/ minimum that cites enforcing artifacts over prose, a stated boundary between agent-local memory / the repo / any shared knowledge base, authority-boundary sections, hub-and-spoke package docs). Ships templates plus a read-only repo-standards-auditor agent for per-repo (fan-out) conformance audits.
